scope: These five first-pass designs are the sole visual authority. Later simplified alternatives were not selected.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: ANIMOL side-view 2D platformer terrain source sprite sheet, CLEAN PIXEL ART revision 2.
Inputs: image 1 is the actual theme sheet to REDRAW and simplify while preserving its four material identities and a 4-row by 4-column sheet structure. Image 2 is the POSITIVE STYLE REFERENCE for clean flat-color pixel craftsmanship, NOT its boat scene. Image 3 is a NEGATIVE closeup showing messy uneven outlines and ragged shading: eliminate those defects.
Output only one transparent-background sprite sheet. FOUR exactly aligned rows (styles A, B, C, D); FOUR aligned columns (material plane, outer frame, inner-hole frame, macro motif). Sixteen equally sized SQUARE cells on a regular grid with generous transparent gutters. No labels, no text, no grid lines, no decorative background. Each artwork panel is authored on a 128x128 logical pixel grid, displayed at an exact integer enlargement. Use visibly deliberate square pixels.
CRITICAL PIXEL CRAFT: one logical pixel OUTERMOST dark contour, dedicated #1a1c2c, consistent on every straight edge and corner. No doubled dark contours, no unnecessary dark 2x2 knots on diagonal curves. Curves use regular deliberate staircase runs without erratic jaggies or backwards pixel spikes. Reduce curves: outer frame is a geometrically straight square and inner opening is a straight square. Walking top is exactly horizontal in side elevation, no visible slanted top surface. Sides and underside are finished with the same disciplined contour. Broad connected FLAT color shapes, body at most 2 or 3 colors. Shadow bands have fixed width and direction. No gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no dithering, no speckles, no tiny islands of shading, no pinprick highlights, no random scratches, no tiny circles/stitch dashes. No faux raster texture. The body should still look designed, through substantial architectural bands and sparse larger motifs.
Column1 MATERIAL: plain seamless opaque square of the material's primary color, optionally ONE broad continuous rectangular shadow stripe; no outer contour, no frame, no tiny bricks, no tile-by-tile border pattern. Large empty flat areas are desired.
Column2 OUTER FRAME: opaque square, outer contour exactly one logical pixel, decorative edge trim separate from the contour and only 2-4 logical pixels deep, with larger restrained color blocks. The center is the SAME plain material color as column1, not a new pattern. All four sides form orthogonal rails; no rounded or beveled panel silhouette; no protrusions. Corner detail stays within the trim, does not swell the contour. Flat thin walking lip at the top; a neat horizontal finished underside.
Column3 INNER FRAME: same opaque square material plane, with a perfectly square centered transparent 64x64 logical pixel hole (x32,y32) and its thin inward-facing trim. Inner contour also 1 pixel; trim only 2-4px, no rounded/octagonal hole. Outer square here has no external frame: material color continues to its boundaries. This panel supplies inner corner art.
Column4 MOTIF: one sparse clean architectural join ornament centered on transparent background, visually occupying a 4x4 logical-cell overlay; coherent large shapes with the same 1pixel outline, no grain or tiny detached marks. Preserve motif theme but simplify busy decoration. It must NOT be used as repeating body texture.
Palette: use only this existing Sweetie16 set with few colors per material: #1a1c2c #5d275d #b13e53 #ef7d57 #ffcd75 #a7f070 #38b764 #257179 #29366f #3b5dc9 #41a6f6 #73eff7 #f4f4f4 #94b0c2 #566c86 #333c57. No additional color ramps. Explicitly favor flat simple color grouping like image2 over surface detail like image1.
Theme-specific directions follow:
Moon palace, jade and lacquer architecture. Row A: teal jade slabs, pale ivory/gold thin walking lip, teal plain body. Row B: warm orange copper locking bands, plum shadows, gold walking lip, warm orange plain body; motif a restrained square coin joint. Row C: blue-cyan compressed jade block, blue plain body, ivory cap, simple plum/gold pressure clamps as motif. Row D: plum lacquer eave bridge, gold/ivory flat lip, plum plain body, teal/orange eave join motif with clean horizontal beam. Retain regal Korean fantasy feeling, no moon-rice-cake bridge, no tiny ornate scrolls.
